*Kallimni Arabi Bishweesh — Unit 1 (lessons 1–3). Learning to express possession in Egyptian Arabic.*

## Warm-up

What do you have in your bag?

<details class="frase">

<summary>تخيل إنك بتفتح شنطتك دلوقتي.. يا ترى فيها إيه؟</summary>

[ta5ayyel ennak betefta7 shantetak delwa2ti.. ya tara fiha eh?]{.fr} [Imagine you're opening your bag right now… what's inside?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>موبايل؟ مفاتيح؟ كتاب؟</summary>

[mobail? mafati7? ketab?]{.fr} [A phone? Keys? A book?]{.en}

</details>

In this lesson we learn how to say which things we have with us — and which things we don't.

## Dialogue

<details class="frase">

<summary>— هي عندها أصحاب؟</summary>

[heyya 3andaha as7ab?]{.fr} [Does she have friends?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>— أيوه، عندها أصحاب كتير في الفصل.</summary>

[aywa, 3andaha as7ab kitir fel fasl.]{.fr} [Yes, she has many friends in the class.]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>— هي عندها ساعة؟</summary>

[heyya 3andaha sa3a?]{.fr} [Does she have a watch?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>— لا، هي ماعندهاش ساعة، عندها موبايل.</summary>

[la2, heyya ma3andahash sa3a, 3andaha mobail.]{.fr} [No, she doesn't have a watch, she has a phone.]{.en}

</details>

## Key vocabulary

| English        | Arabic | franco  |
|----------------|--------|---------|
| friends        | أصحاب  | as7ab   |
| neighbors      | جيران  | giran   |
| colleague (m.) | زميل   | zimil   |
| colleague (f.) | زميلة  | zimila  |
| watch / hour   | ساعة   | sa3a    |
| mobile phone   | موبايل | mobail  |
| class(room)    | فصل    | fasl    |
| bag            | شنطة   | shanta  |
| keys           | مفاتيح | mafati7 |
| book           | كتاب   | ketab   |

## The rule: عند

In Egyptian Arabic, possession is expressed with **عند** (*3and*) plus a pronoun suffix. There is no verb "to have".

| English  | Pronoun | franco | Possession (عند) | franco  | Negation (ما…ش) | franco      |
|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| I        | أنا     | ana    | عندي             | 3andi   | ماعنديش         | ma3andish   |
| you (m.) | إنتَ     | enta   | عندك             | 3andak  | ماعندكش         | ma3andaksh  |
| you (f.) | إنتي    | enti   | عندك             | 3andik  | ماعندكيش        | ma3andikish |
| he       | هو      | huwwa  | عنده             | 3andu   | ماعندوش         | ma3andush   |
| she      | هي      | heyya  | عندها            | 3andaha | ماعندهاش        | ma3andahash |
| we       | إحنا    | e7na   | عندنا            | 3andina | ماعندناش        | ma3andinash |

## The negation rule

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**ما + عند + pronoun + ش**

*ma + 3and + pronoun + sh*
:::

<details class="frase">

<summary>أنا ماعنديش عربية.</summary>

[ana ma3andish 3arabiyya.]{.fr} [I don't have a car.]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>هو ماعندوش وقت.</summary>

[huwwa ma3andush wa2t.]{.fr} [He doesn't have time.]{.en}

</details>

## What students have most

Survey results from the lesson:

| Item         | Arabic | franco    | \%  |
|--------------|--------|-----------|-----|
| mobile phone | موبايل | mobail    | 95% |
| watch        | ساعة   | sa3a      | 60% |
| laptop       | لابتوب | labtob    | 45% |
| car          | عربية  | 3arabiyya | 20% |

<details class="frase">

<summary>أغلب الطلاب عندهم موبايلات، لكن قليل اللي عندهم عربيات.</summary>

[a8lab et-tollab 3andohom mobailat, lakin 2alil elli 3andohom 3arabiyyat.]{.fr} [Most students have mobile phones, but few have cars.]{.en}

</details>

## Exercise: عندك إيه؟ (1-3-ج)

Choose 5 pictures and ask a classmate: **عندك ….؟**

| English  | Arabic  | franco    |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| cat      | قطة     | 2otta     |
| ball     | كورة    | kora      |
| camera   | كاميرا  | kamera    |
| glasses  | نظارة   | naddara   |
| car      | عربية   | 3arabiyya |
| computer | كمبيوتر | kombyuter |

Model conversation:

<details class="frase">

<summary>— يا أحمد، عندك كاميرا؟</summary>

[ya A7mad, 3andak kamera?]{.fr} [Ahmed, do you have a camera?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>— لا، ماعنديش كاميرا، بس عندي موبايل.</summary>

[la2, ma3andish kamera, bas 3andi mobail.]{.fr} [No, I don't have a camera, but I have a phone.]{.en}

</details>

## Group activity

Ask the person next to you 3 questions about things they have in their bag or at home. Example questions:

<details class="frase">

<summary>عندك أخوات؟</summary>

[3andak a5awat?]{.fr} [Do you have siblings?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>عندك عجلة؟</summary>

[3andak 3agala?]{.fr} [Do you have a bicycle?]{.en}

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>عندك قاموس عربي؟</summary>

[3andak 2amus 3arabi?]{.fr} [Do you have an Arabic dictionary?]{.en}

</details>

## Summary

<details class="frase">

<summary>دلوقتي إحنا نقدر نعبر عن الملكية والنفي بالعامية المصرية!</summary>

[delwa2ti e7na ne2dar ne3abbar 3an el-melkeyya wen-nafy bel-3ammeyya el-masreyya!]{.fr} [Now we can express possession and negation in Egyptian Arabic!]{.en}

</details>
